notes: Completed Phase 2 of architectural refactoring. Key accomplishments: (1) Fixed critical bug where TitleManager was missing methods called by createTitleHandlers (setFontFamily, setFontSize, setFontColor, setBackgroundColor, setAlignment, showBackground); (2) Fixed memory leaks in BackgroundManager.setImage() and createOverlayHandlers.handleOverlayImageChange() by disposing old images before replacement; (3) Fixed Vue reactivity issue in TitleManager by using array mutations (splice/length=0) instead of reassignment to preserve array reference; (4) Added documentation to LayoutManager setters clarifying they are configuration changes not tracked by UndoManager; (5) Added 7 unit tests for new TitleManager style setter methods; (6) All 882 unit tests pass with 0 failures. World-review identified these issues and provided valuable architectural feedback. Learnings captured in new document.
